newsitem.title: UK: BA says amended US airways lawsuit "without merit".
newsitem.headline: BA says amended US airways lawsuit "without merit".

text.p: British Airways Plc on Wednesday said US Airways' decision to amend a lawsuit against it demonstrated that the case was "completely without merit."

"The amended complaint today filed by US airways is a recognition that the original lawsuit filed last July was completely without merit and likely to have been dismissed by the court," British Airways (BA) said in a statement.
US Airways said in Arlington Va. that it was expanding its lawsuit to include alleged breach of fiduciary duty by BA representatives on the US Airways board.
Its original suit alleged that BA's alliance with American Airlines violated terms of a similar alliance US Airways signed with BA in 1993.
It also alleged BA and American Airlines violated U.S. anti-trust laws, that BA failed to act in good faith and that it breached its fiduciary duty to US airways as a joint venture partner.
"Information produced in the preliminary document discovery process does not support any of the allegations made in the amended lawuit," BA said.
"At all times British Airways has fulfilled its obligations, contractual or otherwise and the BA directors on the US Airways board have complied fully with their fiduciary responsibilities.
"We intend to move promptly to dismiss the amended complaint," the statement said.
